title_lines: 7.1    FTCL was incorporated in Pakistan on December 26, 2014 as a public limited company. The principal
activity of FTCL includes operation and maintenance of transmission lines, electrical transmission
facilities, electrical circuits, transformers & sub-stations and the movement & delivery of electric power.
The commercial operations of FTCL are expected to commence subsequent to June 30, 2021. FTCL is
in the process of finalising an agreement with Fatima Energy Ltd. to transmit electricity.
